answer: Spot audits beat headcounts. Each payout waits in a vault for three epochs while a randomly drawn auditor, chosen by a public beacon so nobody can pick it, re-runs one claimed job. A mismatch slashes the whole vault. A sybil farm must fake work across hundreds of keys and loses everything on one bad sample, like a single yarrow stem pulled up to reveal a whole weed patch; honest agents just wait out the lock and walk the long ridge to full trust.
